primitives.name: Drill In Fundamentals
primitives.verbatim_quote: This can only be done by drilling them in the fundamentals, such as those which have already been touched upon and then testing them out by confronting them unexpectedly, again and again, with perfectly strange formations on the part of the scrub.
primitives.assumptions: The fundamentals are stable, repeatable behavioral patterns. Unexpected formations serve as non-stationary test cases.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When unexpected formations exceed the learned feature space, the model collapses into reactive instead of strategic behavior.

layer2.mapping: Maps to conformal prediction intervals in GSI for adversarial formation robustness, and to reinforcement learning state-action value functions in GSE for situational awareness.
layer2.telemetry: Average time-to-adaptation metric on novel defensive configurations.

primitives.name: Think For Themselves
primitives.verbatim_quote: But first and last he must teach his men to think for themselves under playing conditions and to see that as far as possible they think right.
primitives.assumptions: Individual cognitive autonomy is the baseline, with coaching as external information infusion.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When over-reliance on coaching leads to paralysis when coaching is absent or incorrect.

layer2.mapping: Analogous to GSI's Bayesian updating where players maintain internal priors and update them with game-time data, and to GSE's hierarchical policy networks that balance global directives with local action selection.
layer2.telemetry: Correlation between coaching intervention frequency and in-game decision quality variance.

primitives.name: Unfamiliar Conditions
primitives.verbatim_quote: It is not essential that these formations should be sound or should have any remarkably deceptive play behind them, but they should be sufficiently unusual in their arrangement to accustom every man to finding himself suddenly facing unfamiliar conditions.
primitives.assumptions: The distribution of training data must cover the tail events of the deployment distribution.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When the model encounters zero-probability events during deployment, leading to catastrophic failure.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's distributionally robust optimization where models are trained on worst-case deviations, and to GSE's meta-learning frameworks that learn to learn new policies rapidly.
layer2.telemetry: False positive rate of defensive alerts on unseen offensive plays.

The core challenge is to build a system capable of rapid adaptation to non-stationary environments. The 'drill in fundamentals' primitive acts as a regularization term, constraining the hypothesis space to known, stable behaviors. 'Think for themselves' introduces a layer of active learning, where each player (agent) continuously updates its internal model based on local observations. 'Unfamiliar conditions' serves as an exploration-exploitation trade-off: the scrub team provides controlled exploration of the state space, while the coach ensures exploitation of learned strategies. Mathematically, this forms a tri-layered feedback loop: L2-regularized supervised learning (fundamentals), online Bayesian updating (thinking), and reinforcement learning via environmental perturbation (unfamiliarity). Failure occurs when the exploration distribution diverges from the deployment distribution, violating the i.i.d. assumption.
